Organize these primitives into a hierarchy where parent nodes encompass child regions [S1, unofficial].

Source [S1] explicitly supports this in Section 4.1 ('Hierarchy Generation'), stating that 'primitive regions can then be organized into a directed acyclic graph' and that 'Voxels with similar characteristics can be collected into primitive regions'. Furthermore, the notes and passages describe a process where 'region primitives' are collected into 'coherent volumes that encompass features' (Section 4.1 and notes). The hierarchical structure implies that higher-level nodes (parent volumes/features) encompass the lower-level nodes (primitive regions/voxels). Therefore, every fact in the claim is supported by the evidence.
